abstract: Patients with testicular cancer who have disseminated disease at presentation do not always undergo orchiectomy for diagnosis of staging before initiation of chemotherapy. Between October 1978 and November 1982 orchiectomy was performed following cisplatin combination chemotherapy in 20 patients with disseminated germ cell tumors. There were three patients with residual carcinoma in the removed testis and six patients with teratoma. Therefore, in patients with evidence of a primary testicular neoplasm that was not resected initially, orchiectomy should be performed after chemotherapy. Furthermore, the testis may be a sanctuary site for germ cell malignancies during systemic treatment.
abstract_ja: 精巣がん患者のうち播種性疾患を有する例は、初診時に病期分類のための精巣摘除術を必ずしも受けていない。1978年10月から1982年11月までに、播種性胚細胞腫瘍の患者20例に対してシスプラチン併用化学療法後の精巣摘除術を施行した。残存癌が3例、奇形腫が6例で認められた。したがって、初診時に原発性精巣腫瘍が切除されていない患者では、化学療法後に精巣摘除術を施行すべきである。さらに、精巣は全身治療中に胚細胞系の悪性腫瘍の避難部位となりうる。
